rationale: With only 12 minutes to close, any position risks forced liquidation at market, creating uncontrolled exit risk on a stock that has already moved ~15% intraday on 7x relative volume with no news catalyst — the move is mature and momentum has stalled (last 5 candles show tight consolidation around $12.22-12.23 with declining volume). The risk/reward of entering either direction this late in a volatile, news-less spike is unfavorable; the spread and ATR are manageable but the time constraint and lack of a clear continuation or reversal signal make skipping the prudent choice.
